body: Where is `save_scene_foldings()` defined? I don't see it in this PR or in `master` via searching the repo, and it looks like GHA couldn't find it either. I'm not able to try pulling and building the PR myself, but it sounds like Peter had success with it, so I'm not sure what would be going on...

What is the purpose of storing `res_folds` inside of `res_path`, as well as `res_path` inside of `res_folds` on the line below? From reading this I was thinking it would do
```cpp
res_path.first = anim;
res_path.second = anim->get_path();
```
to match the deleted lines above in the call to `save_resource_folding()`, but that doesn't seem to be the case.

We might not need to even store a pair here, and could potentially just store an array of `anim`s, since their paths should be retrievable by calling `anim->get_path()`. My memory of how exactly this code works is fuzzy, though, so I don't want to claim anything with great certainty.
That code is a work in progress, and you are right, it is incorrect. In any case, res_folds is necessary for the queue.
I think Peter compiled the code before making it a draft. It's still a work in progress.
